chunks.subject: AP Microeconomics
chunks.title: Q2 Short FRQ (5 points) — Set 2: factor market / monopsony (Quartz Excavations)
chunks.content: AP Microeconomics FRQ 2 (Short), 5 points, one per element, including a calculation. Set 2 answer key highlights: state the profit-maximizing number of miners is 4 (where MRP = MRC/wage); state that Quartz Excavations (a monopsony/wage-setting employer) will pay a wage less than $15 and explain why (the firm faces an upward-sloping labor supply and pays below MRP); calculate the total wage bill as $50 and SHOW WORK. Common failure: hiring where MRP≠MRC; stating the wage relationship without the monopsony reasoning; calculation without shown work.

chunks.subject: AP Microeconomics
chunks.title: Q2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2A, 5/5
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 2) scored 5/5 — stated 4 miners (MRP=MRC), the below-$15 wage with the monopsony explanation, and the $50 total wage bill with shown work. Full-credit model.

chunks.subject: AP Microeconomics
chunks.title: Q2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2B, 4/5
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 2) scored 4/5 — earned most elements but lost one, commonly the monopsony wage explanation or the shown work. Illustrates a strong response one point short.

chunks.subject: AP Microeconomics
chunks.title: Q2 Set 2 exemplar — Sample 2C, 2/5
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 2) scored 2/5 — earned about two elements (e.g., the number of miners and one other point), losing the wage-explanation and calculation-with-work points. Illustrates a low factor-market response.
